title: Parity-amplitude spectrum
statement: For the declared reference amplitude, n(A,R,delta,f) equals 2^(R-1)(-1)^A times the coefficient of y^(R-1-f) in (1+y)^(A+R-delta)(1-y)^(-A); at delta=2A+R it vanishes for odd d=R-1-f and has the stated binomial closed form for even d.
